oracleRisk.summary: A positively evidenced funded internal-NAV borrower branch binds the worst material tier: syrupUSDC collateral pricing multiplies its embedded MaplePool.convertToAssets rate, which forwards totalAssets to issuer-governed, upgradeable MaplePoolManager and four strategy AUM reports rather than independent collateral market marks. Block 26197398 confirms nonzero lender shares in this exact market. Current manager implementation, strategy set, governor and pool delegate are pinned; principal/accounted-interest/accrued-interest ledger valuation and governor/delegate default/upgrade discretion are verified in exact published source. This does not assert an arbitrary numerical price setter or claim that impairment alone changes Morpho price: convertToAssets does not subtract unrealizedLosses. Other seven branch tiers remain explicitly opaque pending full quality classification; a known lowest-scoring material internal-NAV branch does not create external-oracle protection, independent failover, freshness guarantees or favorable credit for them. Fresh 2026-10-15 source/runtime and immutable-input reads cover all eight oracles; upstream identities now resolve to Chainlink proxy feeds, the immutable wstETH exchange-rate adapter and the upgradeable Redstone LBTC fundamental-rate feed. Identifying providers and proxy owners does not establish independently guaranteed heartbeat, fallback, signer independence or full administrator closure; the seven incomplete quality classifications remain explicitly opaque.
